## Sports technology at UT Dallas

[Not a single center: a cross-department network tied to teaching and startups.]{.lede}

::: {.pillars}
::: {.card}
[Teach]{.pillar-head}

- **MS in Systems Engineering and Management:** [*Sports Technology Systems* concentration](https://sem.utdallas.edu/program-and-tuition/sports-technology/) (on campus and online)
- Analytics, wearables, athlete performance, fan experience
:::

::: {.card}
[Research]{.pillar-head}

- **8 faculty** across **5 departments**: Bioengineering, Computer Science, Electrical & Computer Eng., Materials Science, Mechanical Eng.
- Movement, AI coaching, wearables, sleep and recovery, materials
:::

::: {.card}
[Translate]{.pillar-head}

- [**UTDesign**](https://utdesign.utdallas.edu/): every engineering and CS senior completes a company-sponsored capstone
- [**Institute for Innovation and Entrepreneurship**](https://innovation.utdallas.edu/), Venture Development Center, faculty spinouts
:::
:::

::: {.notes}
~45 s. Frame: sports tech at UTD is distributed rather than housed in one institute. The concentration answers their interest in teaching; the rest of the talk is the research and the translation pathways.
:::
